welcome: Gate Rally is a checkpoint driving game.
Drive through highlighted gates in order, complete the target laps, and finish as quickly as possible.
You can ask me to switch cars, change lap count, adjust active gates for difficulty, add gates or ramps, start the race, or replay after finishing.
